name: 2D Gaussian Splatting
definition: A surface reconstruction technique that replaces 3D Gaussians with 2D disks to improve spatial localization and recover high-resolution normal maps.
summary: 2D Gaussian Splatting replaces volumetric 3D Gaussians with oriented 2D disks to improve spatial localization, recover high-resolution normal maps, and enhance geometry extraction while maintaining real-time rendering performance.
